remarks: A private drive winds through over four acres of beautifully wooded grounds to this charming five-bedroom home offering exceptional privacy and a flexible floor plan for today's lifestyle. The recently renovated interior features a living room with fireplace and sun-filled dining room, creating elegant spaces for entertaining. Open-plan kitchen, breakfast area, and family room with a wood-burning stove is where you will spend most of your time. Functional mudroom with new custom cabinetry and laundry is right off the kitchen. The gorgeous sunroom opens to one of multiple stone terraces, free-form pool, and fenced yard. A firepit and seating area complete the perfect setting for outdoor gatherings. Primary suite features walk-in closets, a spacious bath with separate tub and double vanity,  and adjoining space that would be great for a nursery or second office. A separate guest suite above the three-car garage, offers a bedroom, living room, and full bath, ideal for an au pair or in-laws. Customize the lower level to fit your needs, with game room, gym, workshop, and plumbing in place for a future bath. A side yard with trampoline and a perfect hill for sledding add to the property's year-round appeal.
